run.name: QXO, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (QXO)
run.summary: QXO has ample liquidity but heavy, acquisition-driven borrowings that cannot yet be measured against the earnings of the enlarged group. The view is cautious and depends on TopBuild and Kodiak delivering earnings and on add-backs fading. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net sales, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA (company-defined), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 6,111 (including 3,000 of notes raised for TopBuild) over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 724.8, which excludes TopBuild and has Kodiak for three months. Net uses unrestricted cash 2,774 only; 3,000 of escrow cash excluded. Not pro forma. Excludes leases.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 724.8 over LTM cash interest 221.0 (138.0 plus 106 less 23); window holds two coupons on the 2032 notes. Excludes interest on the 2031 notes, the 2034 notes and the 3,000 incremental term loan, which did not yet pay cash interest.

cash.basis: Cash. Unrestricted cash; undrawn is the stated ABL availability of 1.93 billion, which the filing counts in its total liquidity of 4.70 billion. Excludes 3,000 of restricted escrow cash released on July 1, 2026. ABL has 11 drawn and 62 of letters of credit.

cashflow.basis: Cash from operations, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Post-closing earnings, cash and purchase accounting are not reported, and the adjusted earnings measure relies on large add-backs.
CP-1 main limitation: TopBuild earnings, balance sheet and the 3,000 incremental term loan are not in any reported period, and adjusted EBITDA relies on large add-backs.
